answer: Toward Hercules — apex of the Sun's way. Peer-reviewed quote: "Herschel placed the apex in the constellation of Hercules near the star l (lambda) Herculis with equatorial coordinates of a = 17h 31m, d = +26°.1." Page quote: "The solar apex is in the constellation of Hercules near the star Vega." Speed by LSR: classical "speed of the Sun towards the solar apex was taken to be about 20 km/s" for 30+ years before 1986, later "reducing overall speed to about 13.4 km/s."
